track.title: Homayoun: Mavalian, Chakavak, Shebh-e Zarbi Chakavak
track.notes: Tagged title: Mavalian, Chakavak va Shebhe Zarbi Chakavak. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk4 and dwells most on Bb in Mavalian. The line peaks at Cs5 (538.2 Hz) at 0:26.1. It closes on Gk4, not the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → Bb4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4).
